minimumMeaningfulDifference.statement: Recall is averaged over 31 queries, so one query flipping moves mean recall by at most 1/31 = 0.032 (3.2 percentage points). A gap of 1 query (3.2 pts) between two adapters is indistinguishable from a single judgement call and MUST be read as noise; a gap of 2 queries (6.5 pts) is suggestive but not a result; only a gap of 3 or more queries (>=9.7 pts) is interpretable as a real difference. Any claim that adapter A beats adapter B MUST quote the query-count delta, not only the percentage. This artefact resolves against the Hungarian vault-hu corpus only (454 atoms, 298 of them Hungarian), so its numbers are NOT comparable with runs over the runner-docs or MDN corpora.
minimumMeaningfulDifference.notes: relevantAtomIds are author judgements made by reading the atom bodies, never by running a retriever and never by grepping the query terms. They are believed sufficient, not provably exhaustive: an unlisted atom that also answers a query depresses measured precision equally for every adapter, so cross-adapter comparison stays valid while absolute precision is a lower bound. The set is deliberately weighted toward inflected-form queries (10 of 31): Hungarian is agglutinative, and in every one of those the query carries a different suffixed form than the atom body does, so a retriever that matches surface tokens without stemming or subword robustness is expected to lose them. The corpus is single-domain (x_domain=docs) and single-type (type=knowledge), so domain/type filters cannot discriminate here — the two domain-filtered queries exercise the filter path, not a partition.

variantNote: F3 LENGTH CONTROL for golden-set-hu-deinjected.v1.json. Same topic ids and IDENTICAL relevantAtomIds. Drops the SAME NUMBER of surface tokens per topic as the de-injected arm, but chooses WHICH by a deterministic FNV-1a hash of "<topicId>:<index>:<token>" rather than by provenance. It exists because the de-injected arm shortens every query it touches, so a drop in its score is ambiguous between "those particular terms carried the signal" and "fewer query terms score worse". Comparing de-injected against THIS arm separates the two: equal scores mean length, not provenance, explains the move. The hash seed is frozen in this file, so the arm re-runs bit-identical. Same hu-023-style fallback rule, recorded per record.
